prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A small ink glyph — a circle inscribed with a half-filled triangle,
symbolizing transition between states. Blood-red hot ink, simple enough
to read at 16px.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink and watercolor archival plate, a stark lifecycle glyph on aged parchment, centered on warm vellum cream with deep blood-red pigment as the sole accent.

subjects.description: Bold circle inscribed with a half-filled triangle, crisp nib-pen linework, flat ink fill on lower half, clean minimal silhouette readable at 16px.
